install_tell: docker run -p 8080:8080 provectuslabs/kafka-ui — AUTH_TYPE defaults to DISABLED, must be explicitly set to LOGIN_FORM/OAUTH2/LDAP to enable
misconfig_patterns: AUTH_TYPE env var not set (shipped default DISABLED)

response_markers: React SPA title: UI for Apache Kafka
active_probe.false_positive_check: distinctive title string, low FP; likely highest-population wrapper in this category as of 2026 (successor to Kafdrop/AKHQ mindshare)

deployment_tells: multi-cluster config in one UI — one exposed instance can bridge to several backend Kafka clusters at once
pivot_paths: Schema Registry subjects, Kafka Connect connectors, ksqlDB query execution surface when connected
multi-cluster connection configs may embed broker creds
